title: Watch: Why has Trump been so eager to welcome Xi?
description: President Donald Trump has been talking about Chinese President Xi Jinping's visit for months, the BBC's Sarah Smith looks at why.

title: Anti-migrant activist charged after dinghy slashed in Channel
description: Activist Daniel Thomas is charged in connection with an incident in the English Channel on Tuesday.

title: White House restores access to media outlets banned by Trump after judge's order
description: Lawyers for CNN, Politico and MS Now are seeking an emergency court hearing, saying the White House "repeatedly violated" the order.

title: Netanyahu defends Israeli military action as delegates walk out before UN speech
description: The Israeli leader labels those who left his speech at the UN General Assembly as "moral cowards".

title: Poland says fire at Starlink station is sabotage as Denmark warns of rising Russian threat
description: The satellite station is used in part to provide internet coverage to neighbouring Ukraine, the government says.

title: Man jailed for two years over throwing bottle at Portsmouth migrant protest
description: Del Somerville, 42, pleaded guilty to violent disorder following an overnight protest at Eastney.

title: 'We are living a constant nightmare,' mother of poison seller victim tells hearing
description: Tanya Whitaker broke down before she spoke of how her son Samuel's death had devastated her family.

title: Ex-England striker Andy Carroll reveals he was sexually assaulted in 2021
description: Former England striker Andy Carroll reveals he was sexually assaulted in 2021, by a man who has subsequently been jailed for three years.

title: Crashed RAF jet steered to 'avoid built-up areas' before pilots ejected, commander says
description: Gp Capt Gez Currie said the pilots are in hospital, and their families are with them.
